questions.question_english:

II. Their total monthly income must not exceed ₹9,000 plus DA.

questions.explanation_english: I, II, and III For parents to be eligible for Leave Travel Concession, three mandatory conditions must be fulfilled: they must be wholly dependent, their monthly income must not exceed nine thousand rupees plus Dearness Relief, and they must reside with the employee or remain at the declared Home Town.

Reject the claim because return travel took place in January 2024
Split the outward and return fares across two blocks
Adjust the entire claim against the 2024–2025 block

questions.question_english: An employee who has been suspended from service pending a disciplinary inquiry wishes to avail of LTC. Which of the following statements is true regarding this situation?

The employee cannot avail LTC for self, but dependent family members can avail it
The suspended employee can avail of LTC benefits only for travel to the declared Home Town
The suspended employee and their family members are completely barred from availing LTC benefits
questions.explanation_english: The employee cannot avail LTC for self, but dependent family members can avail it A Government servant placed under suspension pending disciplinary proceedings cannot personally avail of Leave Travel Concession benefits during the suspension period. However, this restriction does not apply to their dependent family members.
